#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""FastStarter project CLI — stdlib argparse (no extra CLI library).

From the project root (venv active, deps installed; ``.env`` optional — falls back to ``.env.example``):

    python manage.py init
    python manage.py run
    python manage.py users
    python manage.py report --name "Student Name" --id "816000000"
    python manage.py usecase
    python manage.py skills-verify
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys
from pathlib import Path


def _ensure_models_loaded() -> None:
    import app.models  # noqa: F401


def cmd_init(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    """Create database tables (drops existing by default) and seed demo users."""
    from app.config import get_settings
    from app.database import drop_all, ensure_db_and_tables

    _ensure_models_loaded()
    if args.drop:
        print("Dropping all tables…")
        # Drop can fail on a brand-new empty DB; create path still retries.
        try:
            drop_all()
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            from app.database import is_db_not_ready_error

            if not is_db_not_ready_error(exc):
                raise
            print(f"Database not ready yet while dropping ({exc}); continuing…")
    print("Creating tables…")
    ensure_db_and_tables()
    print(f"Database ready ({get_settings().database_uri}).")
    if getattr(args, "seed", True):
        cmd_seed(args)


def cmd_seed(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    """Insert demo users.

    bob / bobpass       (regular_user)
    admin / adminpass   (admin)
    """
    from app.database import ensure_db_and_tables, get_cli_session
    from app.repositories.user import UserRepository
    from app.repositories.prize import PrizeRepository
    from app.repositories.volunteer_log import VolunteerLogRepository
    from app.repositories.redemption import RedemptionRepository
    from app.models.prize import Prize
    from app.models.volunteer_log import VolunteerLog
    from app.models.redemption import Redemption
    from sqlmodel import select
    from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta
    from app.schemas.user import AdminCreate, RegularUserCreate
    from app.utilities.security import encrypt_password

    _ensure_models_loaded()
    ensure_db_and_tables()

    demo_users = [
        ("bob", "bob@example.com", "bobpass", "regular_user"),
        ("admin", "admin@example.com", "adminpass", "admin"),
    ]

    created = 0
    skipped = 0
    with get_cli_session() as session:
        repo = UserRepository(session)
        for username, email, password, role in demo_users:
            if repo.get_by_username(username):
                print(f"  skip  {username} (already exists)")
                skipped += 1
                continue
            payload_cls = AdminCreate if role == "admin" else RegularUserCreate
            repo.create(
                payload_cls(
                    username=username,
                    email=email,
                    password=encrypt_password(password),
                    role=role,
                )
            )
            print(f"  create {username} ({role})")
            created += 1

        prize_repo = PrizeRepository(session)
        seed_prizes = [
            Prize(name="Campus T-shirt", hours_cost=10, stock=5, delivery_type="manual"),
            Prize(name="Recognition Certificate", hours_cost=50, stock=6, delivery_type="instant"),
            Prize(name="Apex Medal", hours_cost=15, stock=0, delivery_type="manual"),
        ]
        for prize in seed_prizes:
            if not session.exec(select(Prize).where(Prize.name == prize.name)).first():
                prize_repo.save(prize)
                print(f"  create prize {prize.name}")

        users = {
            username: repo.get_by_username(username)
            for username, _, _, role in demo_users
            if role != "admin"
        }
        volunteer_repo = VolunteerLogRepository(session)
        sample_logs = {
            "bob": [(12, "approved"), (15, "approved"), (15, "approved"), (4, "pending"), (3, "rejected")],
        }
        for username, entries in sample_logs.items():
            user = users[username]
            if volunteer_repo.get_by_user_id(user.id):
                continue
            for index, (hours, status) in enumerate(entries):
                volunteer_repo.create(
                    VolunteerLog(
                        user_id=user.id,
                        event_name=f"Volunteer Activity {index + 1}",
                        hours=hours,
                        event_date=date.today() - timedelta(days=index + 2),
                        submitted_at=datetime.utcnow() - timedelta(days=index + 1),
                        proof="img/demo-proof.svg",
                        additional_info="Seeded demo activity",
                        status=status,
                        rejection_reason="Please upload clearer proof." if status == "rejected" else None,
                    )
                )

        redemption_repo = RedemptionRepository(session)
        shirt = prize_repo.get_all()[0] if prize_repo.get_all() else None
        if shirt:
            for username in ("bob",):
                user = users[username]
                if not redemption_repo.get_by_user_id(user.id):
                    redemption_repo.create(
                        Redemption(
                            user_id=user.id,
                            prize_id=shirt.prize_id,
                            redeemed_at=datetime.utcnow() - timedelta(days=2),
                            status="pending",
                        )
                    )

    print(f"Seed done — created {created}, skipped {skipped}.")
    print("Login with bob/bobpass or admin/adminpass")


def cmd_run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    """Start the FastAPI app with Uvicorn."""
    import uvicorn

    from app.config import get_settings

    settings = get_settings()
    bind_host = args.host or settings.app_host
    bind_port = args.port or settings.app_port
    if args.reload is None:
        use_reload = settings.env.lower() != "production"
    else:
        use_reload = args.reload
    print(f"Starting FastStarter on http://{bind_host}:{bind_port} (reload={use_reload})")
    uvicorn.run(
        "app.main:app",
        host=bind_host,
        port=bind_port,
        reload=use_reload,
    )


def cmd_report(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    """Build the submission package: merge judge, package transcripts, write PDF.

    Guide must (1) write ``docs/judge.md`` and (2) pull every Guide chat into
    ``docs/transcripts/*.md`` before this command. Report only packages those files.
    """
    from app.report_pdf import export_report
    from app.skill_integrity import format_report, verify

    result = export_report(
        name=args.name,
        student_id=args.student_id,
        source=None if args.src is None else Path(args.src),
        output=None if args.output is None else Path(args.output),
    )
    print()
    print("Report package:")
    print(
        f"  Judge:       {'merged docs/judge.md' if result.judge_merged else 'MISSING - Guide must run student-judge first'}"
    )
    print(
        f"  Transcripts: {result.transcript_count} chat(s) in docs/transcripts/"
        + (
            ""
            if result.transcript_count
            else " (EMPTY - Guide must pull Copilot/Cursor/OpenCode chats first)"
        )
    )
    if result.transcript_zip:
        print(f"  Zip:         {result.transcript_zip.as_posix()}")
    print(f"  PDF:         {result.pdf_path.as_posix()}")
    print(format_report(verify()))


def cmd_transcripts(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    """Package agent-written markdown under docs/transcripts/ (+ zip)."""
    from app.transcript_export import package_transcripts

    result = package_transcripts(make_zip=not args.no_zip)
    if result.found == 0:
        print(
            "Warning: no chat markdown in docs/transcripts/. "
            "The Guide agent must pull every Guide chat for this project "
            "(Copilot Agent, Cursor, or OpenCode) into docs/transcripts/<slug>.md first."
        )
        raise SystemExit(2)
    print(f"Submission package ready: {result.out_dir}")
    if result.zip_path:
        print(f"Zip for submission: {result.zip_path}")


def cmd_skills_verify(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    """Check course skill files against .agents/skills.lock.json."""
    from app.skill_integrity import format_report, verify

    result = verify()
    print(format_report(result))
    if not result.ok:
        raise SystemExit(1)


def cmd_usecase(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    """Render docs/diagrams/use-case.json to a UML use-case PNG."""
    from app.usecase_diagram import render_usecase_png

    dest = render_usecase_png(
        spec_path=None if args.spec is None else Path(args.spec),
        output=None if args.output is None else Path(args.output),
    )
    print(f"Wrote {dest}")


def cmd_skills_lock(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    """Rewrite the skill lockfile (course authors only)."""
    from app.skill_integrity import write_lock

    dest = write_lock()
    print(f"Wrote {dest}")


def cmd_users(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    """List users currently in the database."""
    from sqlmodel import select

    from app.database import get_cli_session
    from app.models.user import User

    _ensure_models_loaded()
    with get_cli_session() as session:
        users = session.exec(select(User)).all()
        if not users:
            print("No users found. Run: python manage.py init")
            return
        for user in users:
            print(
                f"  id={user.id}  username={user.username}  "
                f"role={user.role}  email={user.email}"
            )


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="python manage.py",
        description="FastStarter Python CLI — init database, seed demo data, run the app.",
    )
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    p_init = sub.add_parser(
        "init",
        help="Create DB tables and seed demo users (drops existing tables by default)",
    )
    p_init.add_argument(
        "--no-drop",
        dest="drop",
        action="store_false",
        help="Create tables without dropping existing ones",
    )
    p_init.add_argument(
        "--no-seed",
        dest="seed",
        action="store_false",
        help="Skip demo user seed after creating tables",
    )
    p_init.set_defaults(drop=True, seed=True, func=cmd_init)

    p_seed = sub.add_parser(
        "seed",
        help="Insert demo users only (idempotent; also runs as part of init)",
    )
    p_seed.set_defaults(func=cmd_seed)

    p_run = sub.add_parser("run", help="Start the web app (uvicorn)")
    p_run.add_argument("--host", default=None, help="Bind host")
    p_run.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=None, help="Bind port")
    reload_group = p_run.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    reload_group.add_argument(
        "--reload", dest="reload", action="store_true", default=None, help="Enable auto-reload"
    )
    reload_group.add_argument(
        "--no-reload", dest="reload", action="store_false", help="Disable auto-reload"
    )
    p_run.set_defaults(func=cmd_run, reload=None)

    p_users = sub.add_parser("users", help="List users in the database")
    p_users.set_defaults(func=cmd_users)

    p_report = sub.add_parser(
        "report",
        help=(
            "Build submission package: merge docs/judge.md, package docs/transcripts/, "
            "write docs/report.pdf (Guide pulls chats + runs student-judge first)"
        ),
    )
    p_report.add_argument("--name", required=True, help="Student name (printed on the PDF cover)")
    p_report.add_argument("--id", dest="student_id", required=True, help="Student ID (PDF only)")
    p_report.add_argument("--src", default=None, help="Markdown path (default: docs/report.md)")
    p_report.add_argument("--output", default=None, help="PDF path (default: docs/report.pdf)")
    p_report.set_defaults(func=cmd_report)

    p_transcripts = sub.add_parser(
        "transcripts",
        help="Package agent-written docs/transcripts/*.md into INDEX + zip (no IDE scrape)",
    )
    p_transcripts.add_argument(
        "--no-zip",
        action="store_true",
        help="Skip writing docs/transcripts.zip",
    )
    p_transcripts.set_defaults(func=cmd_transcripts)

    p_usecase = sub.add_parser(
        "usecase",

# COMP 3613 Assignment 1

Draft this file with the Guide. **Update it after every phase milestone** before you pause. The use-case diagram is a UML PNG at `docs/diagrams/use-case.png`, linked from this file as `diagrams/use-case.png` (path relative to `docs/report.md`). The model diagram is Mermaid. **Embed wireframe images** as `wireframes/<file>` (files live in `docs/wireframes/`).

Do not put your student ID in this file if you will commit it. The PDF cover adds your name and ID at export time.

## Assigned project

Student Awards (incentive system)

## Three workflows

### 1. Submit and Approve Volunteer Hours (Student, Admin)

### 2. Track Milestones and Leaderboard Progress (Student)

### 3. Redeem Hours for Prizes (Student; Admin fulfilment for selected prizes)

## Use case diagram

![Use case diagram](diagrams/use-case.png)

Phase 2 decisions: “Submit Volunteer Hours” includes the always-required “Approve
Volunteer Hours” step. “Track Milestones and Leaderboard Progress” is represented as
separate Student use cases. The prize list is part of “Redeem Hours for Prizes”.
Conditional Admin fulfilment is modelled as “Fulfil Prize Redemption” extending
“Redeem Hours for Prizes”; the base redemption use case is associated with Student.

## Model diagram

Phase 3 first draft. One User submits many VolunteerLogs, and one User creates many
Redemptions. One Prize can be selected by many Redemptions. Milestones are independent
threshold definitions; each user's progress is calculated from their approved
VolunteerLogs rather than stored as a direct Milestone relationship.

```mermaid
erDiagram
  USER ||--o{ VOLUNTEER_LOG : submits
  USER ||--o{ REDEMPTION : creates
  PRIZE ||--o{ REDEMPTION : selected_for

  USER {
    string username
    string email
    string password
    string role "Student or Admin"
    int userId PK
  }

  VOLUNTEER_LOG {
    int logId PK
    int userId FK
    string eventName
    float hours
    date eventDate
    datetime submittedAt
    string additionalInfo
    string proof
    string status "pending, approved, or rejected"
    string rejectionReason
  }

  MILESTONE {
    int milestoneId PK
    string title
    string badge
    float requiredHours
  }

  PRIZE {
    int prizeId PK
    string name
    string imageUrl
    float hoursCost
    int stock
    string deliveryType "instant or manual"
  }

  REDEMPTION {
    int redemptionId PK
    int userId FK
    int prizeId FK
    datetime redeemedAt
    datetime fulfilledAt
    string status "pending or fulfilled"
  }
```

Business rules: only approved VolunteerLogs count toward milestone progress and prize
eligibility. A rejected VolunteerLog requires a rejectionReason. A Redemption requires
sufficient approved hours and available Prize stock. Update this model in Phase 5 if
polish reveals a need for stored progress, additional redemption details, or other
fields.

## Wireframes

The separate student-crafted wireframes cover all six use cases in the diagram.
The composite board is included as an overview.

### Student Home

![Student Home](wireframes/StudentHome.png)

### Submit Volunteer Hours

![Submit Volunteer Hours](wireframes/SubmitHours.png)

### Leaderboard and Milestones

![Leaderboard and Milestones](wireframes/LeaderboardAndMilestones.png)

### Prizes and Redemptions

![Prizes and Redemptions](wireframes/PrizesAndRedemptions.png)

### Admin Console

![Admin Console](wireframes/AdminConsole.png)

### Complete wireframe board

![Complete wireframe board](wireframes/Final_Wireframe.png)

Phase 4 model revisions accepted from the wireframe:

- `VOLUNTEER_LOG.eventDate` and `submittedAt` — shown on submission and history records.
- `VOLUNTEER_LOG.additionalInfo` — shown as optional context on the submission form.
- `VOLUNTEER_LOG.proof` — shown by upload and “View Proof” actions.
- `REDEMPTION.redeemedAt` and `fulfilledAt` — shown in history and fulfilment actions.
- `PRIZE.imageUrl` — supports the prize image area.

Milestone earned dates are derived from the approved volunteer-log dates rather than
stored as a separate milestone field. Dashboard balances, participant counts,
leaderboard sorting, and admin filters are calculated views of the existing entities.

## Theming

The product is branded as **Apex Awards**, with a small gold star in the wordmark.
The visual direction is school-spirit inspired: deep navy backgrounds, gold action
accents, white surfaces, and light blue supporting text. Manrope is used for a
clean, professional type system across the public and authenticated shells.

The theme is applied to the landing page, login page, registration page, and the
authenticated sidebar. Starter placeholder copy and decorative orb elements were
removed; the landing page now introduces student achievement, volunteer hours,
milestones, leaderboard progress, and rewards. `/config` remains available.

## Implementation notes

### Workflow 1: Submit and Approve Volunteer Hours

Added the `VolunteerLog` SQLModel, repository read/create operations, a
`VolunteerHoursService`, and the student volunteer-hours page. The student GET
route remains thin and delegates data access to the service/repository layers.
The submission form accepts an image proof upload and creates a pending log.

Phase 5 polish applied from wireframe review: required fields now show `*`,
additional information is labelled optional, the redundant top-right Submit
hours button was removed, Cancel was added, and the current navigation item is
highlighted accurately. Primary actions use the Apex Awards gold accent with
navy secondary actions. Both browser and service validation require hours above
zero and reject future event dates. The service also rejects non-image proof.

Verification note: student to run the app and test a valid submission, an
invalid hours value, a future date, and a non-image proof file.

Authentication polish: the default local access-token lifetime is eight hours
so a student is not unexpectedly signed out while completing a submission.
JWT expiry validation remains enabled.

The admin side of this workflow is a separate `/admin` console with its own
shell rather than the student navigation. Admins can review pending
submissions, identify the student, inspect event details and dates, view proof,
approve a submission, or reject it with a required reason. Admin login lands on
the console, and direct visits to student workflow pages redirect admins back
to the console.

Additional wireframe polish: student pages now use a full-width horizontal
header with an active Submit Hours tab, and the volunteer-hours view uses a
two-column form/review layout with a proof dropzone, verification tip, and
submission status list. The layout collapses to one column on smaller screens.
Student Home now also presents live lifetime hours, pending hours, submission
count, milestone progress, and recent submissions instead of the starter
placeholder.

Submit Hours polish now separates rejected submissions into their own panel,
including the administrator's rejection reason. Selecting a proof image shows
its filename and an immediate image preview before submission.

### Workflow 2: Track Milestones and Leaderboard Progress

Added a dedicated `/app/progress` page. Milestone progress is derived from
approved volunteer logs, and the leaderboard ranks users by approved hours.
Pending and rejected hours do not contribute. The route is thin and delegates
calculation to `VolunteerHoursService`; the student navigation now exposes the
workflow with an active-page state.

Wireframe polish: Submit Hours now presents pending submissions separately with
the pending count and total pending hours, plus a distinct rejected-submissions
block. Leaderboard and Milestones now exclude admin accounts, show current rank,
lifetime hours, total participants, highest badge, badge icons, earned dates,
remaining hours, milestone state, and reward-unlock text.

### Workflow 3: Redeem Hours for Prizes

Added `Prize` and `Redemption` models, repositories, a `PrizeService`, and the
student `/app/prizes` catalog. Spendable balance is calculated from approved
volunteer hours minus prior redemptions. The catalog enforces available stock
and sufficient balance; instant prizes are fulfilled immediately, while manual
prizes become pending. Redemption history shows the prize, cost, date, and
status. The admin console now includes a manual prize fulfilment queue with a
Mark fulfilled action. Demo prize records are seeded by `python manage.py init`.

Prize UI polish: the catalog self-populates the default prizes when an older
database has no prize rows, and existing default rows receive branded static
artwork. Spendable Balance is visually emphasized as the primary metric while
redemption count and hours redeemed remain secondary stats. Redeem opens a
modal confirmation dialog containing the selected prize image, name, cost, and
confirmation action.

Final wireframe data polish: seed now adds five student accounts with varied
approved totals, pending and rejected submissions, demo proof artwork, and
pending manual redemptions. Student headers show the current bronze, silver, or
gold badge with a distinct icon and color. The Admin Console now shows summary
stats, side-by-side volunteer and prize queues, green Approve and red Reject
actions, and a rejection-reason modal. Student Home now combines live balance,
rank, badges, next milestone, recent submissions, latest badge, and top-three
leaderboard information.

The demo seed was then reduced to the existing `bob` and `admin` accounts only.
Bob receives enough approved, pending, rejected, and redemption records to
exercise the workflow states without creating additional logins. Student Home
View details now opens a modal containing all submitted fields and proof; the
rejection reason section is shown only for rejected records. Badge emblems use
distinct bronze, silver, and gold colors and shapes. The admin stats runtime
error was fixed by initializing the redemption repository used by the admin
summary calculation.

Additional prize wireframe polish: compact redemption statistics now sit beside
the page heading, with Spendable Balance visually emphasized. Redemption
history spans the available page width and includes Prize Name, Hours Cost,
Date, and Status headers, plus manual-delivery and pickup instructions.

## Deployed app

Phase 6. Public Render URL (not localhost). Markers open this to mark the three workflows.

https://

## Logins

Every account a marker needs, including extra users you added. Starter accounts:

- bob / bobpass — regular user
- admin / adminpass — admin

## YouTube URL

## Session transcripts

Filled when the Guide builds the report: the agent writes each Guide chat to `docs/transcripts/<slug>.md` (Copilot Agent, Cursor, or OpenCode). `python manage.py report` packages them. Do not paste chats here during the build.

## Competency (student-judge)

Filled when the report is built. Guide runs student-judge, writes `docs/judge.md`, and export appends the scorecard here.

## Skill integrity

Filled by `python manage.py report`. Do not edit the course skills.

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Depends, Request
from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, RedirectResponse
from fastapi import status
from app.dependencies.session import SessionDep
from app.dependencies.auth import AuthDep, IsUserLoggedIn, get_current_user, is_admin
from app.services.volunteer_hours_service import VolunteerHoursService
from app.services.prize_service import PrizeService
from . import router, templates


@router.get("/app", response_class=HTMLResponse)
async def user_home_view(
    request: Request,
    user: AuthDep,
    db:SessionDep
):
    if user.role == "admin":
        return RedirectResponse(url=request.url_for("admin_home_view"), status_code=303)
    service = VolunteerHoursService(db)
    logs = service.get_student_logs(user.id)
    approved_hours = sum(log.hours for log in logs if log.status == "approved")
    pending_hours = sum(log.hours for log in logs if log.status == "pending")
    badge = service.get_badge_info(user.id)
    leaderboard = service.get_leaderboard(user.id)
    progress = service.get_progress(user.id)
    upcoming_events = service.get_upcoming_events()
    prize_summary = PrizeService(db).get_catalog(user.id)
    next_milestone = next((item for item in progress["milestones"] if not item["achieved"]), progress["milestones"][-1])
    return templates.TemplateResponse(
        request=request, 
        name="app.html",
        context={
            "user": user,
            "logs": logs,
            "approved_hours": approved_hours,
            "pending_hours": pending_hours,
            "badge": badge,
            "leaderboard": leaderboard,
            "progress": progress,
            "next_milestone": next_milestone,
            "spendable_balance": prize_summary["spendable_balance"],
            "upcoming_events": upcoming_events,
        }
    )

# COMP 3613 Assignment 1

Draft this file with the Guide. **Update it after every phase milestone** before you pause. The use-case diagram is a UML PNG at `docs/diagrams/use-case.png`, linked from this file as `diagrams/use-case.png` (path relative to `docs/report.md`). The model diagram is Mermaid. **Embed wireframe images** as `wireframes/<file>` (files live in `docs/wireframes/`).

Do not put your student ID in this file if you will commit it. The PDF cover adds your name and ID at export time.

## Assigned project

Student Awards (incentive system)

## Three workflows

### 1. Submit and Approve Volunteer Hours (Student, Admin)

### 2. Track Milestones and Leaderboard Progress (Student)

### 3. Redeem Hours for Prizes (Student; Admin fulfilment for selected prizes)

## Use case diagram

![Use case diagram](diagrams/use-case.png)

Phase 2 decisions: “Submit Volunteer Hours” includes the always-required “Approve
Volunteer Hours” step. “Track Milestones and Leaderboard Progress” is represented as
separate Student use cases. The prize list is part of “Redeem Hours for Prizes”.
Conditional Admin fulfilment is modelled as “Fulfil Prize Redemption” extending
“Redeem Hours for Prizes”; the base redemption use case is associated with Student.

## Model diagram

Phase 3 first draft. One User submits many VolunteerLogs, and one User creates many
Redemptions. One Prize can be selected by many Redemptions. Milestones are independent
threshold definitions; each user's progress is calculated from their approved
VolunteerLogs rather than stored as a direct Milestone relationship.

```mermaid
erDiagram
  USER ||--o{ VOLUNTEER_LOG : submits
  USER ||--o{ REDEMPTION : creates
  PRIZE ||--o{ REDEMPTION : selected_for

  USER {
    string username
    string email
    string password
    string role "Student or Admin"
    int userId PK
  }

  VOLUNTEER_LOG {
    int logId PK
    int userId FK
    string eventName
    float hours
    date eventDate
    datetime submittedAt
    string additionalInfo
    string proof
    string status "pending, approved, or rejected"
    string rejectionReason
  }

  MILESTONE {
    int milestoneId PK
    string title
    string badge
    float requiredHours
  }

  PRIZE {
    int prizeId PK
    string name
    string imageUrl
    float hoursCost
    int stock
    string deliveryType "instant or manual"
  }

  REDEMPTION {
    int redemptionId PK
    int userId FK
    int prizeId FK
    datetime redeemedAt
    datetime fulfilledAt
    string status "pending or fulfilled"
  }
```

Business rules: only approved VolunteerLogs count toward milestone progress and prize
eligibility. A rejected VolunteerLog requires a rejectionReason. A Redemption requires
sufficient approved hours and available Prize stock. Update this model in Phase 5 if
polish reveals a need for stored progress, additional redemption details, or other
fields.

## Wireframes

The separate student-crafted wireframes cover all six use cases in the diagram.
The composite board is included as an overview.

### Student Home

![Student Home](wireframes/StudentHome.png)

### Submit Volunteer Hours

![Submit Volunteer Hours](wireframes/SubmitHours.png)

### Leaderboard and Milestones

![Leaderboard and Milestones](wireframes/LeaderboardAndMilestones.png)

### Prizes and Redemptions

![Prizes and Redemptions](wireframes/PrizesAndRedemptions.png)

### Admin Console

![Admin Console](wireframes/AdminConsole.png)

### Complete wireframe board

![Complete wireframe board](wireframes/Final_Wireframe.png)

<!-- student-build:wireframe-coverage
use_case: Submit Volunteer Hours
image: docs/wireframes/SubmitHours.png
covered: yes
-->
<!-- student-build:wireframe-coverage
use_case: Approve Volunteer Hours
image: docs/wireframes/AdminConsole.png
covered: yes
-->
<!-- student-build:wireframe-coverage
use_case: View Milestones
image: docs/wireframes/LeaderboardAndMilestones.png
covered: yes
-->
<!-- student-build:wireframe-coverage
use_case: View Leaderboard Progress
image: docs/wireframes/LeaderboardAndMilestones.png
covered: yes
-->
<!-- student-build:wireframe-coverage
use_case: Redeem Hours for Prizes
image: docs/wireframes/PrizesAndRedemptions.png
covered: yes
-->
<!-- student-build:wireframe-coverage
use_case: Fulfil Prize Redemption
image: docs/wireframes/AdminConsole.png
covered: yes
-->

Phase 4 model revisions accepted from the wireframe:

- `VOLUNTEER_LOG.eventDate` and `submittedAt` — shown on submission and history records.
- `VOLUNTEER_LOG.additionalInfo` — shown as optional context on the submission form.
- `VOLUNTEER_LOG.proof` — shown by upload and “View Proof” actions.
- `REDEMPTION.redeemedAt` and `fulfilledAt` — shown in history and fulfilment actions.
- `PRIZE.imageUrl` — supports the prize image area.

Milestone earned dates are derived from the approved volunteer-log dates rather than
stored as a separate milestone field. Dashboard balances, participant counts,
leaderboard sorting, and admin filters are calculated views of the existing entities.

## Theming

The product is branded as **Apex Awards**, with a small gold star in the wordmark.
The visual direction is school-spirit inspired: deep navy backgrounds, gold action
accents, white surfaces, and light blue supporting text. Manrope is used for a
clean, professional type system across the public and authenticated shells.

The theme is applied to the landing page, login page, registration page, and the
authenticated sidebar. Starter placeholder copy and decorative orb elements were
removed; the landing page now introduces student achievement, volunteer hours,
milestones, leaderboard progress, and rewards. `/config` remains available.

## Implementation notes

### Workflow 1: Submit and Approve Volunteer Hours

Added the `VolunteerLog` SQLModel, repository read/create operations, a
`VolunteerHoursService`, and the student volunteer-hours page. The student GET
route remains thin and delegates data access to the service/repository layers.
The submission form accepts an image proof upload and creates a pending log.

Phase 5 polish applied from wireframe review: required fields now show `*`,
additional information is labelled optional, the redundant top-right Submit
hours button was removed, Cancel was added, and the current navigation item is
highlighted accurately. Primary actions use the Apex Awards gold accent with
navy secondary actions. Both browser and service validation require hours above
zero and reject future event dates. The service also rejects non-image proof.

Verification note: student to run the app and test a valid submission, an
invalid hours value, a future date, and a non-image proof file.

Authentication polish: the default local access-token lifetime is eight hours
so a student is not unexpectedly signed out while completing a submission.
JWT expiry validation remains enabled.

The admin side of this workflow is a separate `/admin` console with its own
shell rather than the student navigation. Admins can review pending
submissions, identify the student, inspect event details and dates, view proof,
approve a submission, or reject it with a required reason. Admin login lands on
the console, and direct visits to student workflow pages redirect admins back
to the console.

Additional wireframe polish: student pages now use a full-width horizontal
header with an active Submit Hours tab, and the volunteer-hours view uses a
two-column form/review layout with a proof dropzone, verification tip, and
submission status list. The layout collapses to one column on smaller screens.
Student Home now also presents live lifetime hours, pending hours, submission
count, milestone progress, and recent submissions instead of the starter
placeholder.

Submit Hours polish now separates rejected submissions into their own panel,
including the administrator's rejection reason. Selecting a proof image shows
its filename and an immediate image preview before submission.

### Workflow 2: Track Milestones and Leaderboard Progress

Added a dedicated `/app/progress` page. Milestone progress is derived from
approved volunteer logs, and the leaderboard ranks users by approved hours.
Pending and rejected hours do not contribute. The route is thin and delegates

student `/app/prizes` catalog. Spendable balance is calculated from approved
volunteer hours minus prior redemptions. The catalog enforces available stock

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""FastStarter project CLI — stdlib argparse (no extra CLI library).

From the project root (venv active, deps installed; ``.env`` optional — falls back to ``.env.example``):

    python manage.py init
    python manage.py run
    python manage.py users
    python manage.py report --name "Student Name" --id "816000000"
    python manage.py usecase
    python manage.py skills-verify
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys
from pathlib import Path


def _ensure_models_loaded() -> None:
    import app.models  # noqa: F401


def cmd_init(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    """Create database tables (drops existing by default) and seed demo users."""
    from app.config import get_settings
    from app.database import drop_all, ensure_db_and_tables

    _ensure_models_loaded()
    if args.drop:
        print("Dropping all tables…")
        # Drop can fail on a brand-new empty DB; create path still retries.
        try:
            drop_all()
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            from app.database import is_db_not_ready_error

            if not is_db_not_ready_error(exc):
                raise
            print(f"Database not ready yet while dropping ({exc}); continuing…")
    print("Creating tables…")
    ensure_db_and_tables()
    print(f"Database ready ({get_settings().database_uri}).")
    if getattr(args, "seed", True):
        cmd_seed(args)


def cmd_seed(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    """Insert demo users and a complete multi-student workflow dataset.

    bob / bobpass       (regular_user)
    admin / adminpass   (admin)
    """
    from app.database import ensure_db_and_tables, get_cli_session
    from app.repositories.user import UserRepository
    from app.repositories.prize import PrizeRepository
    from app.repositories.volunteer_log import VolunteerLogRepository
    from app.repositories.redemption import RedemptionRepository
    from app.models.prize import Prize
    from app.models.volunteer_log import VolunteerLog
    from app.models.redemption import Redemption
    from sqlmodel import select
    from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta
    from app.schemas.user import AdminCreate, RegularUserCreate
    from app.utilities.security import encrypt_password

    _ensure_models_loaded()
    ensure_db_and_tables()

    student_users = [("bob", "bob@example.com", "bobpass")]
    student_users.extend(
        (f"student{index:02d}", f"student{index:02d}@example.com", "studentpass")
        for index in range(1, 25)
    )
    demo_users = [*[(username, email, password, "regular_user") for username, email, password in student_users], ("admin", "admin@example.com", "adminpass", "admin")]

    created = 0
    skipped = 0
    with get_cli_session() as session:
        repo = UserRepository(session)
        for username, email, password, role in demo_users:
            if repo.get_by_username(username):
                print(f"  skip  {username} (already exists)")
                skipped += 1
                continue
            payload_cls = AdminCreate if role == "admin" else RegularUserCreate
            repo.create(
                payload_cls(
                    username=username,
                    email=email,
                    password=encrypt_password(password),
                    role=role,
                )
            )
            print(f"  create {username} ({role})")
            created += 1

        prize_repo = PrizeRepository(session)
        seed_prizes = [
            Prize(name="Campus T-shirt", image_url="img/prize-shirt.svg", hours_cost=10, stock=8, delivery_type="manual"),
            Prize(name="Recognition Certificate", image_url="img/prize-certificate.svg", hours_cost=50, stock=12, delivery_type="instant"),
            Prize(name="Apex Medal", image_url="img/prize-medal.svg", hours_cost=15, stock=0, delivery_type="manual"),
        ]
        for prize in seed_prizes:
            if not session.exec(select(Prize).where(Prize.name == prize.name)).first():
                prize_repo.save(prize)
                print(f"  create prize {prize.name}")

        users = {
            username: repo.get_by_username(username)
            for username, _, _, role in demo_users
            if role != "admin"
        }
        volunteer_repo = VolunteerLogRepository(session)
        approved_hours_by_student = [
            5, 10, 15, 20, 24, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 49, 50, 55,
            60, 65, 70, 75, 80, 85, 90, 99, 100, 110, 125, 150,
        ]
        for student_index, approved_hours in enumerate(approved_hours_by_student):
            username = student_users[student_index][0]
            user = users[username]
            if volunteer_repo.get_by_user_id(user.id):
                continue
            volunteer_repo.create(
                VolunteerLog(
                    user_id=user.id,
                    event_name="Community Volunteer Day",
                    hours=approved_hours,
                    event_date=date.today() - timedelta(days=student_index + 2),
                    submitted_at=datetime.utcnow() - timedelta(days=student_index + 1),
                    proof="img/demo-proof.svg",
                    additional_info="Seeded approved demo activity",
                    status="approved",
                )
            )

        extra_submissions = [
            ("student01", 4, "pending", "Library sorting shift"),
            ("student08", 3, "pending", "Campus clean-up support"),
            ("student15", 5, "pending", "Food bank collection"),
            ("bob", 2, "rejected", "Community outreach event"),
            ("student20", 3, "rejected", "Sports day support"),
        ]
        for index, (username, hours, status, event_name) in enumerate(extra_submissions):
            user = users[username]
            if any(log.event_name == event_name for log in volunteer_repo.get_by_user_id(user.id)):
                continue
            volunteer_repo.create(
                VolunteerLog(
                    user_id=user.id,
                    event_name=event_name,
                    hours=hours,
                    event_date=date.today() - timedelta(days=index + 1),
                    submitted_at=datetime.utcnow() - timedelta(hours=index + 3),
                    proof="img/demo-proof.svg",
                    additional_info="Seeded demo submission",
                    status=status,
                    rejection_reason="Please upload clearer proof." if status == "rejected" else None,
                )
            )

        redemption_repo = RedemptionRepository(session)
        shirt = prize_repo.get_all()[0] if prize_repo.get_all() else None
        prizes = prize_repo.get_all()
        if prizes:
            redemption_pairs = [
                (student_users[index][0], prizes[index % len(prizes)])
                for index in range(15)
            ]
            for index, (username, prize) in enumerate(redemption_pairs):
                user = users[username]
                if not redemption_repo.get_by_user_id(user.id):
                    redemption_repo.create(
                        Redemption(
                            user_id=user.id,
                            prize_id=prize.prize_id,
                            redeemed_at=datetime.utcnow() - timedelta(days=index + 1),
                            fulfilled_at=(datetime.utcnow() - timedelta(days=index)) if prize.delivery_type == "instant" else None,
                            status="fulfilled" if prize.delivery_type == "instant" else "pending",
                        )
                    )

    print(f"Seed done — created {created}, skipped {skipped}.")
    print("Login with bob/bobpass or admin/adminpass")


def cmd_run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    """Start the FastAPI app with Uvicorn."""
    import uvicorn

    from app.config import get_settings

    settings = get_settings()
    bind_host = args.host or settings.app_host
    bind_port = args.port or settings.app_port
    if args.reload is None:
        use_reload = settings.env.lower() != "production"
    else:
        use_reload = args.reload
    print(f"Starting FastStarter on http://{bind_host}:{bind_port} (reload={use_reload})")
    uvicorn.run(
        "app.main:app",
        host=bind_host,
        port=bind_port,
        reload=use_reload,
    )


def cmd_report(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    """Build the submission package: merge judge, package transcripts, write PDF.

    Guide must (1) write ``docs/judge.md`` and (2) pull every Guide chat into
    ``docs/transcripts/*.md`` before this command. Report only packages those files.
    """
    from app.report_pdf import export_report
    from app.skill_integrity import format_report, verify

    result = export_report(
        name=args.name,
        student_id=args.student_id,
        source=None if args.src is None else Path(args.src),
        output=None if args.output is None else Path(args.output),
    )
    print()
    print("Report package:")
    print(
        f"  Judge:       {'merged docs/judge.md' if result.judge_merged else 'MISSING - Guide must run student-judge first'}"
    )
    print(
        f"  Transcripts: {result.transcript_count} chat(s) in docs/transcripts/"
        + (
            ""
            if result.transcript_count
            else " (EMPTY - Guide must pull Copilot/Cursor/OpenCode chats first)"
        )
    )
    if result.transcript_zip:
        print(f"  Zip:         {result.transcript_zip.as_posix()}")
    print(f"  PDF:         {result.pdf_path.as_posix()}")
    print(format_report(verify()))


def cmd_transcripts(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    """Package agent-written markdown under docs/transcripts/ (+ zip)."""
    from app.transcript_export import package_transcripts

    result = package_transcripts(make_zip=not args.no_zip)
    if result.found == 0:
        print(
            "Warning: no chat markdown in docs/transcripts/. "
            "The Guide agent must pull every Guide chat for this project "
            "(Copilot Agent, Cursor, or OpenCode) into docs/transcripts/<slug>.md first."
        )
        raise SystemExit(2)
    print(f"Submission package ready: {result.out_dir}")
    if result.zip_path:
        print(f"Zip for submission: {result.zip_path}")


def cmd_skills_verify(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    """Check course skill files against .agents/skills.lock.json."""
    from app.skill_integrity import format_report, verify

    result = verify()
    print(format_report(result))
    if not result.ok:
        raise SystemExit(1)


def cmd_usecase(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    """Render docs/diagrams/use-case.json to a UML use-case PNG."""
    from app.usecase_diagram import render_usecase_png

    dest = render_usecase_png(
        spec_path=None if args.spec is None else Path(args.spec),
        output=None if args.output is None else Path(args.output),
    )
    print(f"Wrote {dest}")


def cmd_skills_lock(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    """Rewrite the skill lockfile (course authors only)."""
    from app.skill_integrity import write_lock

    dest = write_lock()
    print(f"Wrote {dest}")


def cmd_users(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    """List users currently in the database."""
    from sqlmodel import select

    from app.database import get_cli_session
    from app.models.user import User

    _ensure_models_loaded()
    with get_cli_session() as session:
        users = session.exec(select(User)).all()
        if not users:
            print("No users found. Run: python manage.py init")
            return
        for user in users:
            print(
                f"  id={user.id}  username={user.username}  "
                f"role={user.role}  email={user.email}"
            )


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="python manage.py",
        description="FastStarter Python CLI — init database, seed demo data, run the app.",
    )
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    p_init = sub.add_parser(
        "init",
        help="Create DB tables and seed demo users (drops existing tables by default)",
    )
    p_init.add_argument(
        "--no-drop",
        dest="drop",
        action="store_false",
        help="Create tables without dropping existing ones",
    )
    p_init.add_argument(
        "--no-seed",
        dest="seed",
        action="store_false",
        help="Skip demo user seed after creating tables",
    )
    p_init.set_defaults(drop=True, seed=True, func=cmd_init)

    p_seed = sub.add_parser(
        "seed",
        help="Insert demo users only (idempotent; also runs as part of init)",
    )
    p_seed.set_defaults(func=cmd_seed)

    p_run = sub.add_parser("run", help="Start the web app (uvicorn)")
    p_run.add_argument("--host", default=None, help="Bind host")
    p_run.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=None, help="Bind port")
    reload_group = p_run.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    reload_group.add_argument(
        "--reload", dest="reload", action="store_true", default=None, help="Enable auto-reload"
    )
    reload_group.add_argument(
        "--no-reload", dest="reload", action="store_false", help="Disable auto-reload"
    )
    p_run.set_defaults(func=cmd_run, reload=None)

    p_users = sub.add_parser("users", help="List users in the database")
    p_users.set_defaults(func=cmd_users)

    p_report = sub.add_parser(
        "report",
        help=(
            "Build submission package: merge docs/judge.md, package docs/transcripts/, "
            "write docs/report.pdf (Guide pulls chats + runs student-judge first)"
        ),
    )
    p_report.add_argument("--name", required=True, help="Student name (printed on the PDF cover)")
    p_report.add_argument("--id", dest="student_id", required=True, help="Student ID (PDF only)")
    p_report.add_argument("--src", default=None, help="Markdown path (default: docs/report.md)")
    p_report.add_argument("--output", default=None, help="PDF path (default: docs/report.pdf)")
    p_report.set_defaults(func=cmd_report)

    p_transcripts = sub.add_parser(
        "transcripts",
        help="Package agent-written docs/transcripts/*.md into INDEX + zip (no IDE scrape)",
    )
    p_transcripts.add_argument(
        "--no-zip",
        action="store_true",
        help="Skip writing docs/transcripts.zip",
    )
    p_transcripts.set_defaults(func=cmd_transcripts)

    p_usecase = sub.add_parser(
        "usecase",
        help="Render docs/diagrams/use-case.json to a UML use-case PNG",
    )
    p_usecase.add_argument("--spec", default=None, help="JSON spec (default: docs/diagrams/use-case.json)")
    p_usecase.add_argument("--output", default=None, help="PNG path (default: docs/diagrams/use-case.png)")
    p_usecase.set_defaults(func=cmd_usecase)

    p_skills_verify = sub.add_parser(
        "skills-verify",
        help="Check course skills against .agents/skills.lock.json",
    )
    p_skills_verify.set_defaults(func=cmd_skills_verify)

    p_skills_lock = sub.add_parser(
        "skills-lock",
        help="Rewrite .agents/skills.lock.json (course authors; needs FASTSTARTER_SKILLS_LOCK=1)",
    )
    p_skills_lock.set_defaults(func=cmd_skills_lock)

    return parser


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> None:
    parser = build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    args.func(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1:])

# COMP 3613 Assignment 1

Draft this file with the Guide. **Update it after every phase milestone** before you pause. The use-case diagram is a UML PNG at `docs/diagrams/use-case.png`, linked from this file as `diagrams/use-case.png` (path relative to `docs/report.md`). The model diagram is Mermaid. **Embed wireframe images** as `wireframes/<file>` (files live in `docs/wireframes/`).

Do not put your student ID in this file if you will commit it. The PDF cover adds your name and ID at export time.

## Assigned project

Student Awards (incentive system)

## Three workflows

### 1. Submit and Approve Volunteer Hours (Student, Admin)

### 2. Track Milestones and Leaderboard Progress (Student)

### 3. Redeem Hours for Prizes (Student; Admin fulfilment for selected prizes)

## Use case diagram

![Use case diagram](diagrams/use-case.png)

Phase 2 decisions: “Submit Volunteer Hours” includes the always-required “Approve
Volunteer Hours” step. “Track Milestones and Leaderboard Progress” is represented as
separate Student use cases. The prize list is part of “Redeem Hours for Prizes”.
Conditional Admin fulfilment is modelled as “Fulfil Prize Redemption” extending
“Redeem Hours for Prizes”; the base redemption use case is associated with Student.

## Model diagram

Phase 3 first draft. One User submits many VolunteerLogs, and one User creates many
Redemptions. One Prize can be selected by many Redemptions. Milestones are independent
threshold definitions; each user's progress is calculated from their approved
VolunteerLogs rather than stored as a direct Milestone relationship.

```mermaid
erDiagram
  USER ||--o{ VOLUNTEER_LOG : submits
  USER ||--o{ REDEMPTION : creates
  PRIZE ||--o{ REDEMPTION : selected_for

  USER {
    string username
    string email
    string password
    string role "Student or Admin"
    int userId PK
  }

  VOLUNTEER_LOG {
    int logId PK
    int userId FK
    string eventName
    float hours
    date eventDate
    datetime submittedAt
    string additionalInfo
    string proof
    string status "pending, approved, or rejected"
    string rejectionReason
  }

  MILESTONE {
    int milestoneId PK
    string title
    string badge
    float requiredHours
  }

  PRIZE {
    int prizeId PK
    string name
    string imageUrl
    float hoursCost
    int stock
    string deliveryType "instant or manual"
  }

  REDEMPTION {
    int redemptionId PK
    int userId FK
    int prizeId FK
    datetime redeemedAt
    datetime fulfilledAt
    string status "pending or fulfilled"
  }
```

Business rules: only approved VolunteerLogs count toward milestone progress and prize
eligibility. A rejected VolunteerLog requires a rejectionReason. A Redemption requires
sufficient approved hours and available Prize stock. Update this model in Phase 5 if
polish reveals a need for stored progress, additional redemption details, or other
fields.

## Wireframes

The separate student-crafted wireframes cover all six use cases in the diagram.
The composite board is included as an overview.

### Student Home

![Student Home](wireframes/StudentHome.png)

### Submit Volunteer Hours

![Submit Volunteer Hours](wireframes/SubmitHours.png)

### Leaderboard and Milestones

![Leaderboard and Milestones](wireframes/LeaderboardAndMilestones.png)

### Prizes and Redemptions

![Prizes and Redemptions](wireframes/PrizesAndRedemptions.png)

### Admin Console

![Admin Console](wireframes/AdminConsole.png)

### Complete wireframe board

![Complete wireframe board](wireframes/Final_Wireframe.png)

<!-- student-build:wireframe-coverage
use_case: Submit Volunteer Hours
image: docs/wireframes/SubmitHours.png
covered: yes
-->
<!-- student-build:wireframe-coverage
use_case: Approve Volunteer Hours
image: docs/wireframes/AdminConsole.png
covered: yes
-->
<!-- student-build:wireframe-coverage
use_case: View Milestones
image: docs/wireframes/LeaderboardAndMilestones.png
covered: yes
-->
<!-- student-build:wireframe-coverage
use_case: View Leaderboard Progress
image: docs/wireframes/LeaderboardAndMilestones.png
covered: yes
-->
<!-- student-build:wireframe-coverage
use_case: Redeem Hours for Prizes
image: docs/wireframes/PrizesAndRedemptions.png
covered: yes
-->
<!-- student-build:wireframe-coverage
use_case: Fulfil Prize Redemption
image: docs/wireframes/AdminConsole.png
covered: yes
-->

Phase 4 model revisions accepted from the wireframe:

- `VOLUNTEER_LOG.eventDate` and `submittedAt` — shown on submission and history records.
- `VOLUNTEER_LOG.additionalInfo` — shown as optional context on the submission form.
- `VOLUNTEER_LOG.proof` — shown by upload and “View Proof” actions.
- `REDEMPTION.redeemedAt` and `fulfilledAt` — shown in history and fulfilment actions.
- `PRIZE.imageUrl` — supports the prize image area.

Milestone earned dates are derived from the approved volunteer-log dates rather than
stored as a separate milestone field. Dashboard balances, participant counts,
leaderboard sorting, and admin filters are calculated views of the existing entities.

## Theming

The product is branded as **Apex Awards**, with a small gold star in the wordmark.
The visual direction is school-spirit inspired: deep navy backgrounds, gold action
accents, white surfaces, and light blue supporting text. Manrope is used for a
clean, professional type system across the public and authenticated shells.

The theme is applied to the landing page, login page, registration page, and the
authenticated sidebar. Starter placeholder copy and decorative orb elements were
removed; the landing page now introduces student achievement, volunteer hours,
milestones, leaderboard progress, and rewards. `/config` remains available.

## Implementation notes

### Workflow 1: Submit and Approve Volunteer Hours

Added the `VolunteerLog` SQLModel, repository read/create operations, a
`VolunteerHoursService`, and the student volunteer-hours page. The student GET
route remains thin and delegates data access to the service/repository layers.
The submission form accepts an image proof upload and creates a pending log.

Phase 5 polish applied from wireframe review: required fields now show `*`,
additional information is labelled optional, the redundant top-right Submit
hours button was removed, Cancel was added, and the current navigation item is
highlighted accurately. Primary actions use the Apex Awards gold accent with
navy secondary actions. Both browser and service validation require hours above
zero and reject future event dates. The service also rejects non-image proof.

Verification note: student to run the app and test a valid submission, an
invalid hours value, a future date, and a non-image proof file.

Authentication polish: the default local access-token lifetime is eight hours
so a student is not unexpectedly signed out while completing a submission.
JWT expiry validation remains enabled.

The admin side of this workflow is a separate `/admin` console with its own
shell rather than the student navigation. Admins can review pending
submissions, identify the student, inspect event details and dates, view proof,
approve a submission, or reject it with a required reason. Admin login lands on
the console, and direct visits to student workflow pages redirect admins back
to the console.

Additional wireframe polish: student pages now use a full-width horizontal
header with an active Submit Hours tab, and the volunteer-hours view uses a
two-column form/review layout with a proof dropzone, verification tip, and
submission status list. The layout collapses to one column on smaller screens.
Student Home now also presents live lifetime hours, pending hours, submission
count, milestone progress, and recent submissions instead of the starter
placeholder.

Submit Hours polish now separates rejected submissions into their own panel,
including the administrator's rejection reason. Selecting a proof image shows
its filename and an immediate image preview before submission.

### Workflow 2: Track Milestones and Leaderboard Progress

Added a dedicated `/app/progress` page. Milestone progress is derived from
approved volunteer logs, and the leaderboard ranks users by approved hours.
Pending and rejected hours do not contribute. The route is thin and delegates
calculation to `VolunteerHoursService`; the student navigation now exposes the
workflow with an active-page state.

Wireframe polish: Submit Hours now presents pending submissions separately with
the pending count and total pending hours, plus a distinct rejected-submissions
block. Leaderboard and Milestones now exclude admin accounts, show current rank,
lifetime hours, total participants, highest badge, badge icons, earned dates,
remaining hours, milestone state, and reward-unlock text.

### Workflow 3: Redeem Hours for Prizes

Added `Prize` and `Redemption` models, repositories, a `PrizeService`, and the
student `/app/prizes` catalog. Spendable balance is calculated from approved
volunteer hours minus prior redemptions. The catalog enforces available stock
and sufficient balance; instant prizes are fulfilled immediately, while manual
prizes become pending. Redemption history shows the prize, cost, date, and
status. The admin console now includes a manual prize fulfilment queue with a
Mark fulfilled action. Demo prize records are seeded by `python manage.py init`.

Prize UI polish: the catalog self-populates the default prizes when an older
database has no prize rows, and existing default rows receive branded static
artwork. Spendable Balance is visually emphasized as the primary metric while
redemption count and hours redeemed remain secondary stats. Redeem opens a
modal confirmation dialog containing the selected prize image, name, cost, and
confirmation action.

Final wireframe data polish: seed now adds varied approved totals, pending and
rejected submissions, demo proof artwork, and pending manual redemptions for
the existing student account. Student headers show the current bronze, silver, or
gold badge with a distinct icon and color. The Admin Console now shows summary
stats, side-by-side volunteer and prize queues, green Approve and red Reject
actions, and a rejection-reason modal. Student Home now combines live balance,
rank, badges, next milestone, recent submissions, latest badge, and top-three
leaderboard information.

The demo seed was then reduced to the existing `bob` and `admin` accounts only.
Bob receives enough approved, pending, rejected, and redemption records to
exercise the workflow states without creating additional logins. Student Home
View details now opens a modal containing all submitted fields and proof; the
rejection reason section is shown only for rejected records. Badge emblems use
distinct bronze, silver, and gold colors and shapes. The admin stats runtime
error was fixed by initializing the redemption repository used by the admin
summary calculation.

Student Home now includes upcoming volunteer events. Leaderboard filters are
limited to badge and first-name initial; filtering preserves each student's
global rank and does not introduce hour sorting. Leaderboard and milestone
pages use the same colored badge designs as the header.

The final `python manage.py init` seed was verified with 25 student accounts,
30 volunteer logs (`25 approved`, `3 pending`, `2 rejected`), 3 prizes, and 15
redemptions. Approved-hour totals range across no-badge, Bronze, Silver, and
Gold thresholds.

Additional prize wireframe polish: compact redemption statistics now sit beside
the page heading, with Spendable Balance visually emphasized. Redemption
history spans the available page width and includes Prize Name, Hours Cost,
Date, and Status headers, plus manual-delivery and pickup instructions.

## Deployed app

Phase 6. Public Render URL (not localhost). Markers open this to mark the three workflows.

https://

## Logins

Every account a marker needs, including extra users you added. Starter accounts:

- bob / bobpass — regular user
- admin / adminpass — admin

## YouTube URL

## Session transcripts

Filled when the Guide builds the report: the agent writes each Guide chat to `docs/transcripts/<slug>.md` (Copilot Agent, Cursor, or OpenCode). `python manage.py report` packages them. Do not paste chats here during the build.

## Competency (student-judge)

Filled when the report is built. Guide runs student-judge, writes `docs/judge.md`, and export appends the scorecard here.

## Skill integrity

Filled by `python manage.py report`. Do not edit the course skills.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""FastStarter project CLI — stdlib argparse (no extra CLI library).

From the project root (venv active, deps installed; ``.env`` optional — falls back to ``.env.example``):

    python manage.py init
    python manage.py run
    python manage.py users
    python manage.py report --name "Student Name" --id "816000000"
    python manage.py usecase
    python manage.py skills-verify
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys
from pathlib import Path


def _ensure_models_loaded() -> None:
    import app.models  # noqa: F401


def cmd_init(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    """Create database tables (drops existing by default) and seed demo users."""
    from app.config import get_settings
    from app.database import drop_all, ensure_db_and_tables

    _ensure_models_loaded()
    if args.drop:
        print("Dropping all tables…")
        # Drop can fail on a brand-new empty DB; create path still retries.
        try:
            drop_all()
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            from app.database import is_db_not_ready_error

            if not is_db_not_ready_error(exc):
                raise
            print(f"Database not ready yet while dropping ({exc}); continuing…")
    print("Creating tables…")
    ensure_db_and_tables()
    print(f"Database ready ({get_settings().database_uri}).")
    if getattr(args, "seed", True):
        cmd_seed(args)


def cmd_seed(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    """Insert demo users and a complete multi-student workflow dataset.

    bob / bobpass       (regular_user)
    admin / adminpass   (admin)
    """

        ("Hana Adams", "hana.adams@example.com", "studentpass"),
        ("Daniel Baker", "daniel.baker@example.com", "studentpass"),
    ]
    demo_users = [*[(username, email, password, "regular_user") for username, email, password in student_users], ("admin", "admin@example.com", "adminpass", "admin")]

                            redeemed_at=datetime.utcnow() - timedelta(days=index + 1),
                            fulfilled_at=(datetime.utcnow() - timedelta(days=index)) if prize.delivery_type == "instant" else None,
                            status="fulfilled" if prize.delivery_type == "instant" else "pending",
                        )
                    )

    print(f"Seed done — created {created}, skipped {skipped}.")
    print("Login with bob/bobpass or admin/adminpass")


def cmd_run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    """Start the FastAPI app with Uvicorn."""
    import uvicorn

    from app.config import get_settings

    settings = get_settings()
    bind_host = args.host or settings.app_host
    bind_port = args.port or settings.app_port
    if args.reload is None:
        use_reload = settings.env.lower() != "production"
    else:
        use_reload = args.reload
    print(f"Starting FastStarter on http://{bind_host}:{bind_port} (reload={use_reload})")
    uvicorn.run(
        "app.main:app",
        host=bind_host,
        port=bind_port,
        reload=use_reload,
    )


def cmd_report(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    """Build the submission package: merge judge, package transcripts, write PDF.

    Guide must (1) write ``docs/judge.md`` and (2) pull every Guide chat into
    ``docs/transcripts/*.md`` before this command. Report only packages those files.
    """
    from app.report_pdf import export_report
    from app.skill_integrity import format_report, verify

    result = export_report(
        name=args.name,
        student_id=args.student_id,
        source=None if args.src is None else Path(args.src),
        output=None if args.output is None else Path(args.output),
    )
    print()
    print("Report package:")
    print(
        f"  Judge:       {'merged docs/judge.md' if result.judge_merged else 'MISSING - Guide must run student-judge first'}"
    )
    print(
        f"  Transcripts: {result.transcript_count} chat(s) in docs/transcripts/"
        + (
            ""
            if result.transcript_count
            else " (EMPTY - Guide must pull Copilot/Cursor/OpenCode chats first)"
        )
    )
    if result.transcript_zip:
        print(f"  Zip:         {result.transcript_zip.as_posix()}")
    print(f"  PDF:         {result.pdf_path.as_posix()}")
    print(format_report(verify()))


def cmd_transcripts(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    """Package agent-written markdown under docs/transcripts/ (+ zip)."""
    from app.transcript_export import package_transcripts

    result = package_transcripts(make_zip=not args.no_zip)
    if result.found == 0:
        print(
            "Warning: no chat markdown in docs/transcripts/. "
            "The Guide agent must pull every Guide chat for this project "
            "(Copilot Agent, Cursor, or OpenCode) into docs/transcripts/<slug>.md first."
        )
        raise SystemExit(2)
    print(f"Submission package ready: {result.out_dir}")
    if result.zip_path:
        print(f"Zip for submission: {result.zip_path}")


def cmd_skills_verify(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    """Check course skill files against .agents/skills.lock.json."""
    from app.skill_integrity import format_report, verify

    result = verify()
    print(format_report(result))
    if not result.ok:
        raise SystemExit(1)


def cmd_usecase(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    """Render docs/diagrams/use-case.json to a UML use-case PNG."""
    from app.usecase_diagram import render_usecase_png

    dest = render_usecase_png(
        spec_path=None if args.spec is None else Path(args.spec),
        output=None if args.output is None else Path(args.output),
    )
    print(f"Wrote {dest}")


def cmd_skills_lock(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    """Rewrite the skill lockfile (course authors only)."""
    from app.skill_integrity import write_lock

    dest = write_lock()
    print(f"Wrote {dest}")


def cmd_users(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    """List users currently in the database."""
    from sqlmodel import select

    from app.database import get_cli_session
    from app.models.user import User

    _ensure_models_loaded()
    with get_cli_session() as session:
        users = session.exec(select(User)).all()
        if not users:
            print("No users found. Run: python manage.py init")
            return
        for user in users:
            print(
                f"  id={user.id}  username={user.username}  "
                f"role={user.role}  email={user.email}"
            )


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="python manage.py",
        description="FastStarter Python CLI — init database, seed demo data, run the app.",
    )
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    p_init = sub.add_parser(
        "init",
        help="Create DB tables and seed demo users (drops existing tables by default)",
    )
    p_init.add_argument(
        "--no-drop",
        dest="drop",
        action="store_false",
        help="Create tables without dropping existing ones",
    )
    p_init.add_argument(
        "--no-seed",
        dest="seed",
        action="store_false",
        help="Skip demo user seed after creating tables",
    )
    p_init.set_defaults(drop=True, seed=True, func=cmd_init)

    p_seed = sub.add_parser(
        "seed",
        help="Insert demo users only (idempotent; also runs as part of init)",
    )
    p_seed.set_defaults(func=cmd_seed)

    p_run = sub.add_parser("run", help="Start the web app (uvicorn)")
    p_run.add_argument("--host", default=None, help="Bind host")
    p_run.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=None, help="Bind port")
    reload_group = p_run.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    reload_group.add_argument(
        "--reload", dest="reload", action="store_true", default=None, help="Enable auto-reload"
    )
    reload_group.add_argument(
        "--no-reload", dest="reload", action="store_false", help="Disable auto-reload"
    )
    p_run.set_defaults(func=cmd_run, reload=None)

    p_users = sub.add_parser("users", help="List users in the database")
    p_users.set_defaults(func=cmd_users)

    p_report = sub.add_parser(
        "report",
        help=(
            "Build submission package: merge docs/judge.md, package docs/transcripts/, "
            "write docs/report.pdf (Guide pulls chats + runs student-judge first)"
        ),
    )
    p_report.add_argument("--name", required=True, help="Student name (printed on the PDF cover)")
    p_report.add_argument("--id", dest="student_id", required=True, help="Student ID (PDF only)")
    p_report.add_argument("--src", default=None, help="Markdown path (default: docs/report.md)")
    p_report.add_argument("--output", default=None, help="PDF path (default: docs/report.pdf)")
    p_report.set_defaults(func=cmd_report)

    p_transcripts = sub.add_parser(
        "transcripts",
        help="Package agent-written docs/transcripts/*.md into INDEX + zip (no IDE scrape)",
    )
    p_transcripts.add_argument(
        "--no-zip",
        action="store_true",
        help="Skip writing docs/transcripts.zip",
    )
    p_transcripts.set_defaults(func=cmd_transcripts)

    p_usecase = sub.add_parser(
        "usecase",
        help="Render docs/diagrams/use-case.json to a UML use-case PNG",
    )
    p_usecase.add_argument("--spec", default=None, help="JSON spec (default: docs/diagrams/use-case.json)")
    p_usecase.add_argument("--output", default=None, help="PNG path (default: docs/diagrams/use-case.png)")
    p_usecase.set_defaults(func=cmd_usecase)

    p_skills_verify = sub.add_parser(
        "skills-verify",
        help="Check course skills against .agents/skills.lock.json",
    )
    p_skills_verify.set_defaults(func=cmd_skills_verify)

    p_skills_lock = sub.add_parser(
        "skills-lock",
        help="Rewrite .agents/skills.lock.json (course authors; needs FASTSTARTER_SKILLS_LOCK=1)",
    )
    p_skills_lock.set_defaults(func=cmd_skills_lock)

    return parser


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> None:
    parser = build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    args.func(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1:])
